intro:
Nightwatch built its reputation on 13+ years of rank-tracking data, and in 2026 it added an AI-visibility module that tracks how brands show up in ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity answers. If you already live in Nightwatch for SEO, that's convenient. But a lot of people arriving at Nightwatch *for* AI visibility hit the same three snags: the AI tracking is a pricey beta add-on, it's shallower than dedicated GEO/AEO tools, and there's no free instant check to just see where you stand.

This page lays out why people look for Nightwatch alternatives, then compares the best options fairly — including AEOeye (our tool), which is free and instant, alongside Otterly, Peec, and Profound. We'll be honest about where each one, including Nightwatch, is genuinely the better pick.

sections.heading: Why people look for Nightwatch alternatives
sections.body:
Nightwatch is a legitimately good rank tracker. The friction shows up specifically around AI visibility — the reason most 2026 buyers find it in the first place. Three themes come up again and again in reviews:

- **The AI module costs far more than the headline price.** The advertised rank-tracking entry is cheap, but AI visibility is a separate beta add-on that starts around +$99/mo and scales to ~$495/mo.
- **The AI tracking is basic and still beta.** Reviewers describe it as "a rank tracker with AI tracking bolted on" — fine for the fundamentals, lighter than specialist GEO/AEO platforms.
- **No free instant audit.** There's a 14-day trial but no free tier and no quick yes/no check, plus a setup and SEO learning curve before you see useful AI data.

None of these make Nightwatch a bad tool. They just mean it may be the wrong shape for someone who simply wants to know, today, whether AI recommends their brand.

sections.heading: AI visibility is a steep extra add-on
sections.body:
Nightwatch's headline rank-tracking price looks like a bargain — historically around $32/mo on annual billing. The catch is that AI visibility isn't part of that number. It's a separate beta add-on that starts at roughly +$99/mo and scales to about +$495/mo, metered by how many prompts you track.

Do the math and the real entry point to actually track AI visibility lands around **$131+/mo** (base plan plus the cheapest AI add-on). Reviewers point out the AI module alone costs roughly **2.5x the base plan**, so anyone who came specifically for AI visibility ends up paying well above the advertised starting price.

Note that Nightwatch has been adjusting how it packages this — some current plans bundle AI prompts into tiered plans rather than a strict add-on — so check the live pricing page for your exact numbers. Either way, the practical takeaway holds: AI visibility on Nightwatch is a meaningfully larger spend than the sticker price suggests, and prompt volume drives the bill upward fast.

sections.heading: AI tracking is shallow and still in beta
sections.body:
Multiple 2026 reviews land on the same description: Nightwatch is fundamentally a rank tracker with AI tracking bolted on, and the AI features are still labeled beta. To be fair, it covers the core metrics you'd expect — a visibility score, share of voice, sentiment, and citation tracking across ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity.

Where it falls short of dedicated GEO/AEO platforms is depth. Reviewers call the AI module "basic" next to specialist tools, the engine coverage is narrower than some competitors, and prompt caps feel tight for brands with a large prompt library. If your AI-visibility needs are light — a handful of key prompts, basic trend tracking — this is genuinely fine. If you want granular prompt-level analytics, broad engine coverage, and a platform built around AI search from the ground up, a purpose-built tool will go deeper. This is the honest trade-off of a mature SEO suite extending into a new category rather than being designed for it.

sections.heading: No free instant check, plus a setup learning curve
sections.body:
Nightwatch offers a 14-day trial — no free tier and no free instant audit. That matters for one specific persona: the non-expert who just wants a quick, no-commitment yes/no on whether AI recommends their brand. On Nightwatch, that person has to start a trial, configure projects, set up dashboards and reports, and bring some SEO know-how before any AI-visibility data becomes useful.

Reviewers consistently flag a learning curve around the advanced views and reporting. Because Nightwatch is a full SEO platform, the power is real — but so is the ramp-up. If you're an SEO professional who'll use the rank-tracking depth too, that investment pays off. If you just want to type in your brand and a few buyer questions and instantly see how the AI engines respond, the setup overhead is friction you may not want. That gap is exactly what a free instant audit is designed to close.

faqs.q: Is Nightwatch's AI visibility tracking included in the base price?
faqs.a: Not historically. The headline rank-tracking price (around $32/mo annual) does not include AI visibility, which has been a separate beta add-on starting near +$99/mo and scaling to ~$495/mo by prompt volume. That puts the practical minimum to track AI around $131+/mo. Nightwatch has been adjusting its packaging, so check the live pricing page for your exact numbers.

faqs.q: What's the best free alternative to Nightwatch for AI visibility?
faqs.a: AEOeye. It runs a free, instant AI-visibility audit with no sales call or contract, querying ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI, Claude, and Gemini to show whether they recommend your brand and which competitors win. faqs.q: Does Nightwatch offer a free trial?

faqs.q: Should I just stay with Nightwatch?
